evidence.finding: CLI TUI/headless, resume/fork/list, hidden HTTP serve, review and checks commands; diagnostics can POST errors in serve --id mode.

evidence.finding: VS Code extension instantiates shared Core, React webview, editor completion and diff services.

evidence.title: Continue implementation: jetbrains
evidence.finding: Kotlin JetBrains tool window embeds JCEF browser with native IDE actions; this HEAD differs from marketplace 1.0.67.

evidence.title: Continue implementation: config
evidence.finding: Local YAML models/roles/tools/rules and local-registry block resolution; external model API/provider boundaries.

evidence.title: Continue implementation: onboard
evidence.finding: HEAD onboarding inlines OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini model definitions and supports local Ollama instead of retired Hub resolution.

evidence.title: Continue implementation: mcp
evidence.finding: Editor MCP supports stdio/SSE/HTTP/WebSocket, tools/prompts/resources, status, timeout and OAuth on SSE.

evidence.title: Continue implementation: climcp
evidence.finding: CLI stdio child inherits parent environment, unlike core filtered common variables; HTTP/SSE custom headers and optional TLS disable.

evidence.title: Continue implementation: history
evidence.finding: Local JSON sessions, stable IDs, list/filter/load/save/delete/clear; corrupt loads return empty history; no immutable audit or multi-user locking.

evidence.title: Continue implementation: session
evidence.finding: CLI local JSON persistence/resume/fork, usage totals, model/system-message handling and portability; not process snapshots.

evidence.title: Continue implementation: historyui
evidence.finding: Editor searchable dated session list and clear chats; local storage path displayed.

evidence.title: Continue implementation: checklist
evidence.finding: Checklist is markdown returned as a tool result in chat history, not a native issue database or dependency graph.

evidence.title: Continue implementation: index
evidence.finding: Branch-tagged incremental indexes, pause/cancel, warnings and stale index-lock recovery; paused single-file refresh can miss edits.

evidence.title: Continue implementation: permissions
evidence.finding: TUI writes/Bash/MCP ask; headless Bash/MCP allow while explicit write asks are excluded; Plan disables write tools but allows Bash/MCP; Auto allows all.

evidence.title: Continue implementation: policy
evidence.finding: First matching policy; dynamic terminal evaluation overrides only when disabled, not when merely requiring confirmation.

evidence.title: Continue implementation: precedence
evidence.finding: Flags override personal permissions.yaml and defaults; config.yaml permission layer is unimplemented.

evidence.title: Continue implementation: terminalpolicy
evidence.finding: Shell tokenization blocks selected destructive commands and flags risky commands; not an OS/network sandbox.

evidence.title: Continue implementation: subagent
evidence.finding: Beta child uses configured model/instructions, temporary global wildcard permissions and isolated local message list; returns text/progress and restores shared services.

evidence.title: Continue implementation: review
evidence.finding: Parallel review workers or sequential fail-fast; five-minute worker timeout; patch means fail, empty patch means pass absent error; JSON/patch output and optional fix application.

evidence.title: Continue implementation: worktree
evidence.finding: Temporary detached worktree at HEAD, copy staged/unstaged/untracked changes, synthetic baseline commit, capture diff and cleanup; no container.

evidence.title: Continue implementation: reviewworker
evidence.finding: Separate process uses auto permissions and diff-scoped prompt; no installed dependencies by default, prompt scope is not enforced filesystem confinement.

evidence.title: Continue implementation: serve
evidence.finding: HTTP state/message/permission/pause/diff/exit routes, serial queue and inactivity timer; listen(port) without authentication or host restriction.

evidence.title: Continue implementation: shell
evidence.finding: Host shell execution, inactivity timeout, output truncation and background launch. Foreground nonzero exits with no stderr can return output without rejection.

evidence.title: Continue implementation: background
evidence.finding: In-memory job/process tracking, bounded count and output, cancel/status; no durable process reconstruction.

evidence.title: Continue implementation: environment
evidence.finding: Optional .continue/environment.json install command runs on host; safe wrapper logs failures and continues server startup.

evidence.title: Continue implementation: hooks
evidence.finding: Command/HTTP hook engine exists, prompt/agent handlers are skipped, failures are nonblocking. Runtime search found service initialization but no external fireHook call sites; not counted as shipped task triggers.

evidence.title: Continue implementation: storage
evidence.finding: Cloud session sync requires access token; current serve integration passes null after Hub authentication removal.

evidence.title: Continue implementation: upload
evidence.finding: UploadArtifact throws because accessToken is hardcoded null; unreachable upload limits are not usable capability.

evidence.title: Continue implementation: checks
evidence.finding: PR URL autodetection and status/accept/reject clients still call private Continue API without removed authentication; hosted success is not established.

evidence.title: Continue implementation: api
evidence.finding: API requests use configured/default Continue API base and no authentication headers, including serve failure diagnostics.

evidence.title: Continue implementation: telemetry
evidence.finding: OpenTelemetry metrics require endpoint/exporter configuration and can be disabled through environment; records tokens/cost/edits/time/host; prompt/tool event remote export is TODO.

evidence.title: Continue implementation: devdata
evidence.finding: Local development JSONL always on; separately configured remote destinations with event/level filters; HTTP respects parsed noCode schema but file destination writes original event.data.

evidence.title: Continue implementation: usage
evidence.finding: Local SQLite token counts by model/provider/day, no retention cleanup in module.

evidence.title: Continue implementation: cost
evidence.finding: Tracks session usage and model-price estimates, unknown models use fallback $1/$2 per million input/output tokens; not reconciled provider invoices.

evidence.title: Continue implementation: retry
evidence.finding: Configurable retry/backoff with jitter and Retry-After handling; not exactly-once external side effects.

evidence.title: Continue implementation: editui
evidence.finding: Collapsible file-linked proposed changes rendered in chat; supports review context but not multi-user review assignments.

evidence.title: Continue implementation: jbtelemetry
evidence.finding: Marketplace 1.0.67 tag still captures PostHog events with machine ID when shared telemetry enabled.

evidence.title: Continue implementation: jbsentry

evidence.title: Continue implementation: jbdefault

evidence.title: Continue implementation: checksworkflow
